content: I feari mamoeba kasei sina
Yesuma we mawetu utebina takesi muneta uwaraini siosa ueta uwaraini Danu sina naufitae ido fata.
I Ferosi uwaraini tarawatu tisa uwaraini gimumutaroma weita, ewa amarama siosa uwaraini uruama yaubeda ieta itasu weita.

Yesuma emaba kasei sinaroma wei, yabai mui amarama mamoe wani aderedi (100) boboro nono mamoe demurairatu feafisuna mamoe nainiti naini (99) eme ibawa orofaro ekodifite i mamoe demurai doberebe doberebe atafisu. Eno ufisu aba me?
Aiwia eno ufisu. Dawa doberebe doberebe atafite woure eriro odeda yaru ue anibisu.
Suro ane fafite webiro danu su uwaraini domayamutuini fafitaro webisu, nanu fearinu mamoe ataneba naini yaru uawe webisu.
Enanari amara demurai danu siosa ueta dubena afu sabisuna i urero ibinita uwarama yaru derawere ufitate i nainiti naini (99) uwaraba yaru kikiratu ufitaita wei.
I feari oi
Yesuma eno weite mui kasei sina nono eno wei, aweta demurai danu teni (10) siriwa oi boboro nono demurai feafisuna nanefa beafite yawewe aifite doberegou utebe utebe atafisu. Eno ufisu aba me wei?
Aiwia eno ufite webiro danu daikemutuini su su uwaraini fafitaro webisu, nanu fearinu siriwa oi ataneba naini yaru uawe webisu.
Enanari mui amarama danu siosa ueta dubena afu sabisuna Godinu aneruma yaru ufitaita wei.
Mui amaranu feari amaraba kasei sina
Yesuma nono mui kasei sina eno wei, mui amarama amara sadei yanae muni.
I dubu yanae muni amarama wei, baba, anu ibaiabai nesia bebeate nanu mairo muma wei. Eno weiba danu damama enanari ui.
Mui kowaro dubu amara danu ibaiabai nesia fira uteda moana uwarabai oiya uite oi munite mui orofaro ani. Daba yafawere anite i aika orofaro me sara utebe oi nesia sane me sini.
Oi ido sane me siniro i orofaro sinai derawere fariro i amara ido osi woure.
Enoba uyarite mui amarabai gaukara ufie ani. Aniro i amarama wei, aniate nanu boro yawotebea wei. Weiro ido ani.
Dawa osi derawere edebari uteda boronu rau ifie imuiro matawa uta.
I amarama yaubeda imuegou utebe imuite we imui, nanu babanu gaukara uwara faiyawere iro ibeda ieta derawere itaitaro ieta moanaini ibinuro na sinaima uine wei.
Eno we imuite wei, awona uyamate nanu bababai animate eno wemau, baba, Godini aba siosawere utebitara.
Nanu ueta sineta siosawereba anu gaukara amara na odia wemau eno we imuiya wei.
Eno we imuite uyarite danu damamabai ani. I amara ido arebiro danu damama danu amara baworo me etararowere dabaro erite neno arama uteda durami ue mane danu amara yabaite koku ui.
Eno uiro i amarama wei, baba, Godini aba siosawere utebitara. Nanu ueta sineta siosawereba awonana na anu amara da wia wei.

Weiro damamama wei, nanu amara uieta ari usinute feare ibebe awona farinuba kobere wadia woure are yure odiawete age bubuke odiawete buri barueta odiawete reka keweawere borumakau uawete uda uawere ifete yaura ufe weiro enanari uta.
I botai amarama waiyaro gaukara utebe ekodite farina suro buma ureda yaura urebitaro naui.
Nauite mui gaukara amaraba wei, aneba eno utaita wei?
Weiro gaukara amarama wei, anu abue awona idowere farinuba amamama i reka keweawere borumakau urinuro itaisi wei.
Weiro i amara ibo derawere uite suro anawa ui. Dawa i suro anawa uiba damamama wawaro dawabai ido are farite ara nui wei.
Weiro botai amarama wei, oya faiyawere anu gaukara utebe anu sina woroworo munebitarana reka borumakau naba eno ure matawa utasuro nanu naiyemutuini naini yaru utawa utaisi.
Anu amarama anu oi sasae arumamiba me sara sane me sinite owere farinuro kobere reka borumakau urinute yaru utasu wei.
Weiro damamama wei, nanu amara, aini naini uruama ibinitu. Nanu ibaiabai ane anena anu.
Anu abue uieta ari usinute feare ibebe farinuro ataneba iba yaru utaisi wei, Yesuma kasei sina eno wei.
